RAR 1.4-format encrypted compressed split member, generated by an original
DOS-era writer under DOSBox-X: one member, `SOURCE.TXT`, compressed and
password-protected, split into 2 KiB volumes.

SOURCE.TXT is the first 32768 bytes of ../CMULTI.TXT. The password is
`password`. The reference reader tests all three volumes successfully. The
corresponding unencrypted RAR 1.4-format archive has byte-identical packed
data after decrypting the encrypted volumes with one continuous cipher state;
restarting the cipher at each volume boundary diverges at the first byte
of ESPLIT.R00.
